meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把你的网页应用部署到 Vercel(默认为生产环境):部署前先跑本地构建,部署后确认线上地址返回 200 再把链接发给你,也能管理 Vercel 项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布网页应用,或需要管理 Vercel 项目、域名等时触发;动手前它会先跑 vercel whoami 确认授权是否可用。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 先跑本地构建,再部署并检查线上地址

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署
say.note: 执行 vercel ls 查看部署记录

say.text: 从 Vercel 拉取环境变量到本地 .env

howto.what_en: After install, Claude deploys your web app to Vercel with the vercel CLI, runs a local build first, confirms the live URL returns 200 before sharing it, and can also manage Vercel projects, domains, and env vars.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, and env vars; it runs vercel whoami to check auth first.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Runs a local build first, then checks the live URL

say_en.text: Pull Vercel env vars into a local .env
